name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A keyboard-accessible way to move between related panels, with a restrained underline or compact pill treatment.
example:
<Tabs defaultSelectedKey="posts">
  <TabList aria-label="Content"><Tab id="posts">Posts</Tab><Tab id="members">Members</Tab></TabList>
  <TabPanel id="posts">Recent posts</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel id="members">Team members</TabPanel>
</Tabs>
